content: Fluticasone is a corticosteroid medication prescribed to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms such as itching, redness, dryness, and scaling associated with various skin disorders. It may also be prescribed for other uses; consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information. Fluticasone is available as an ointment or cream for topical application. It is typically applied two to four times daily at evenly spaced intervals. Follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Use fluticasone exactly as directed. Do not use more or less of it, or apply it more frequently than prescribed by your doctor. Do not discontinue its use without consulting your doctor. Before application, thoroughly clean the affected area, allow it to dry, and gently rub the medication into the skin until most of it disappears. Use only enough medication to cover the affected area. Wash your hands after applying the medication. If using the scalp lotion, apply it directly from the squeeze bottle to the affected area. Before using fluticasone, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to fluticasone or any other medications. Provide a list of all prescription and nonprescription medications you are currently using, especially skin products containing hydrocortisone or vitamins. Notify your doctor if you have any other medical conditions, infections, or allergies. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, inform your doctor. If you become pregnant while using fluticasone, contact your doctor immediately. If you miss a dose, apply it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not apply a double dose to make up for a missed one. Fluticasone may cause side effects. Notify your doctor if you experience any of the following symptoms, especially if they are severe or persistent: itching, burning, swelling, redness, skin rash, or numbness of the fingers. Store this medication in its original container, tightly closed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture (do not store it in the bathroom). Dispose of any expired or unused medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on proper disposal. Keep all appointments with your doctor while using this medication. Fluticasone is for external use only. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, or mouth, and do not swallow it. Do not apply dressings, bandages, cosmetics, lotions, or other skin medications to the treated area unless directed by your doctor. Do not share this medication with others. If you have questions about refilling your prescription, consult your pharmacist.
